title: Peptidbindung und Biuret-Nachweisgrenze abrufen
titleEn: Recall peptide bonds and the Biuret-test threshold
description: Die lernende Person kann die Peptidbindung und die auf der Karte ausdrücklich begrenzte typische Biuretreaktion mit mindestens zwei passenden Peptidbindungen mithilfe der zugehörigen Lernkarten sicher abrufen.
descriptionEn: The learner can reliably recall the peptide bond and the typical Biuret reaction expressly limited on the card to at least two suitable peptide bonds using the associated flashcards.

memorySupportSelection.role: Recall of previously taught compact content only. No ordinary competency, source duty, acquisition performance, or Human evidence is certified.
memorySupportSelection.selectionSemantics: Unchanged getSrsFilterTags returns the existing goal: tags because no GK/LK or new selector tag is added. The unchanged card filter uses their OR intersection; actual ordered cards are checked, not inferred from selectedCardIds.
